power.title: Turn YouMixer on or off
power.confirm_off: Turn YouMixer off? The music will stop. Your data stays saved.
offline.title: YouMixer is off.
offline.text: Press the red power key at the top right. The first time, your browser will ask whether it may open YouMixer: accept and tick the option to remember your choice.
offline.failed: It didn't start. If your browser asked whether to open YouMixer, accept. If it didn't ask anything, open YouMixer from the Start menu once, or use the installer, to enable this key.
queue.empty_hint: Pick something in <button class="link" data-goto="lists">Lists</button> or create a mix.
queue.save_title: Save the queue as a mix
lists.link_placeholder: Paste a playlist, a mix or a video
lists.clear_title: Clear the selection and go back to adding links
lists.empty: Paste a playlist or mix link above to get started.
lists.auto_on: It will update itself when YouMixer opens
lists.auto_off: It will be kept as it is
lists.shuffled: Shuffled, with no repeats until the end
splitter.title: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
player.autoplay_blocked: Your browser may be blocking autoplay. If it doesn't start, press Play.
player.stalled: “{title}” won't load, moving on to the next one
player.queue_ended: The queue has ended. Turn on Repeat to keep it going.
player.too_many_errors: Stopped after {count} errors in a row. Last one: {reason}. Check your ad blockers and tracking protection.
yterror.101: the video can't be played outside YouTube
yterror.150: the video can't be played outside YouTube
yterror.153: YouTube didn't accept the page's origin
profiles.title: Your profiles
profiles.hint: Each profile has its own lists, queue, history and what YouMixer learns. Keys, the YouTube account and the clock icon are shared by all of them.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.copy: Copy the lists from “{name}”, without what it learned
profiles.delete_prompt: Type {word} to delete the profile “{name}” with its lists and learning
profiles.deleted: Profile deleted. A copy is kept in data/backups/deleted.
create.discovery_hint: New songs based on what you play, what you like and your lists.
create.from.none: You can also start from lists: pick them in the Lists tab.
create.from.one: Also starts from the list selected in Lists.
create.from.other: Also starts from the {count} lists selected in Lists.
activity.forget_artist_title: Forget what was learned about this artist
activity.artist_forgotten: Everything learned about that artist was forgotten
settings.tray_check: Show the YouMixer icon next to the clock while it's on
settings.tray_hint: Click: opens the page. Right-click: open or turn off. If you can't see it, it may be behind the ^ arrow next to the clock; drag it out to keep it always visible.
settings.tray_missing: The icon needs the pystray and pillow packages. Install the requirements and turn YouMixer on again.
settings.bm_hint: Saves exactly the songs you see, from any browser profile or account, with no keys.
settings.bm_step1: Drag this button to the bookmarks bar of each of your browser profiles:
settings.bm_step2: On YouTube or YouTube Music, with the mix or the queue open, click that bookmark.
settings.bm_step3: YouMixer opens, saves the list and the tab closes by itself. The list shows up in Lists.
settings.bm_note: YouMixer has to be on. It saves the songs the page has loaded: about 25 in a YouTube mix. If you want more, let it play on or scroll down the list before clicking.
settings.data_hint: Everything is stored in data/, not in the browser. A copy is made in data/backups at every start, keeping the last 10. If something fails, the details are in data/youmixer.log.
settings.keys_hint: The app works without any of them.
settings.keys_saved: Keys saved. Any previous key was replaced.
settings.account_off: Not connected. Only needed for private lists and liked songs.
settings.import_account: Import my lists and liked songs
settings.login_hint: Open music.youtube.com in the browser profile with the account you want to use. Press F12, open Network, filter by browse, right-click a request with status 200 and choose Copy Value → Copy Request Headers. To switch accounts, disconnect and repeat this with the other one.
bm.drag: Drag it to your bookmarks bar; it's used from YouTube
bm.nothing: YouMixer: I can't see any list here. Open the mix or the queue so its songs are visible and click again.
bm.saved_close: Saved “{name}” ({count} songs). You can close this tab now.
err.not_youtube: That link doesn't look like YouTube.
err.no_songs_found: I couldn't find any songs there. If it's private, connect your account in Settings.
err.not_from_youtube: This list doesn't come from YouTube, so there's nothing to update.
err.busy: Wait until YouMixer finishes what it's doing and try again.
err.no_tracks_received: No songs arrived. Open the mix with its list visible and click the button again.
err.nothing_to_shuffle: There are no songs to shuffle in that selection.
err.no_base: There's nothing to start from yet: import a playlist or type a topic.
err.no_new_songs: No new songs came up. Try another topic or more variety.
err.profile_taken: There's already a profile with that name.
err.profile_main: The Main profile can't be deleted.
err.profile_active: Switch to another profile before deleting this one.
install.protocol: - youmixer:// link registered (the page's power key).
install.shortcut: - “YouMixer” shortcut created in the Start menu.
handoff.moved: YouMixer has opened elsewhere and this tab has stopped so two players don't play at once. You can close it now.
settings.window_hint: Used when turning YouMixer on and when opening it from the clock icon. The key at the top switches it right away.
settings.window_unavailable: Its own window needs Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome installed.
settings.mode_saved: Saved: it will open this way next time
settings.check_updates: Check for new versions when turning on (asks GitHub)
update.none: No versions have been published yet.
update.toast: A new version of YouMixer is available: {version}. The link is in Settings.
welcome.title: Welcome to YouMixer
welcome.s1_text: In Lists, paste the link of a YouTube playlist and press Add. You can add as many as you like. To save a list from your own YouTube account, use the bookmarklet in Settings.
welcome.s2_text: Tick one or more lists and press Shuffle. The order is truly random, and the same artist never plays twice in a row.
welcome.s3_text: Press the heart on songs you love and skip the ones you don't. YouMixer learns your taste, and Create mix builds discoveries from it.
err.job_lost: That task no longer exists. Please try again.
err.port_busy: YouMixer can't start: another program is using port {port}. Close that program and open YouMixer again.
